Based on the onboarding documentation, this happens because **`provider: auto`** (or having active API keys in your environment) enables auto-detection and fallback routing to remote providers.

To prevent Hermes from routing any queries, auxiliary tasks, or fallbacks to OpenRouter or external APIs, you must explicitly configure your local endpoint and disable the fallback providers list:

```yaml
model:
  default: <your-local-model>
  provider: custom
  base_url: <your-local-base-url>  # e.g., http://localhost:11434/v1 or your llama.cpp endpoint
fallback_providers: []
```

### Summary of fixes:
1. **Avoid `provider: auto`**: Explicitly set `provider: custom`.
2. **Clear fallbacks**: Set `fallback_providers: []` in your configuration to disable the fallback chain to external APIs.

*(Note: The onboarding document does not contain details regarding modifying hardcoded internal variables like `_OPENROUTER_MODEL` or auxiliary session-title generation defaults directly in code, but clearing `fallback_providers: []` and avoiding `provider: auto` will prevent Hermes from using external keys for automatic fallbacks.)*
